answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit that only unlocks after a full epoch of verified work, and each new identity must be vouched by a distinct existing agent whose own stake is slashed on collusion. A sybil farm must therefore acquire many independent vouchers and lock real capital per fake identity, making each extra node costlier than its reward. Like a crystal forming under pressure, trust accretes slowly, and every ripple of forged activity is traced back to its source before the dawn of payout, so duplication yields no cheap votes.
